offering_description.value: Designs and sells test and measurement instruments, sensors, and asset management and workflow software to industrial, electronics, and commercial customers. Products are made in-house or by contract partners and sold directly and through distributors, with software sold on subscription.

primary_products.value: test and measurement instruments; sensors and process instruments; industrial automation equipment

primary_services.value: software subscriptions; field service management; asset maintenance and calibration services

customer_segment.value: B2B: manufacturers, electronics makers, utilities, facility operators, and field service organizations

end_markets.value: industrial manufacturing; electronics; energy and utilities; commercial buildings; healthcare

revenue_model.value: product sales: instruments, sensors and automation equipment sold to industrial and electronics customers; subscription: software licenses for asset management, maintenance and workflow platforms; service fees: calibration, repair and maintenance services for installed equipment

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds instruments and sensors, sold to industrial and electronics customers; software / platform: cloud and on-premise asset and workflow software sold to facility and maintenance teams; service provider: calibration and maintenance services for customers' installed equipment
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Worldwide, with major operations and customers in North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: diversified: Two groups: Intelligent Operating Solutions software and Precision Technologies instruments and sensors, serving different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: field sales teams selling to large industrial and enterprise accounts; distributors / dealers: independent distributors and channel partners for instruments and sensors; online: online store and software sign-up for smaller customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Product safety and electrical standards, plus data privacy rules for software, no sector licensing required

notes: Product portfolio and segment structure may have changed; details reflect my best knowledge of the current business.
